request.text: Who are you? I'll carry it. I don't even know who I am. I woke by a stranger's fire with no name and no memory of the road. He is dying, and he wants to talk. He gave me his ember, cold as a stone, and told me to walk with it. I buried him by his fire, and left his stone bare. I didn't know what to write. Sixty-four fires, and not one of them home. There is nothing past the fog. I went to see. The road has started to recognise me.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a neutral, natural southern English voice. Female, 25-35. Excellent quality. Persona: a young wanderer with no memory who carries a dying stranger's ember and writes down the road in a journal. Emotion: thoughtful, earnest, quietly brave, a little lost, warm underneath. A clear, natural, mid-pitched voice, plain and unforced, like someone telling a friend what happened to them; never theatrical, easy to listen to for hours.
